notes.title: The Salted Cookies of Carthaginia v1.3 Update
notes.content:
The 1.3 update is here! Finish off your romantic evening with undead Empress Carthaginia with a night in her bed. 

This update adds an additional sex scene, four new gorgeously rendered CGs, as well as gallery and chapter select functions so you can more easily replay specific content or see new choice branches. And a new television scene about ancient catgirls and their spaceship pyramids.  

Just in time, too, as October is the perfect month for romancing a skeleton babe. 

Happy Halloween!

This is the last currently planned/in production update. When we hit our sales goal of 1500 copies we will add an additional "morning after" scene as a thank you to our fans.

notes.title: v1.2 'Tech Support' Update
notes.content:
The v.1.2 update is now live! Additional scenes have been added:
Learn about pufferfish!
Meet Carthaginia's familiar!
Fix Carthaginia's computer! [strike]Or don't![/strike]
Read Anonymous message board comments!
And more!

Also: The game's soundtrack is now available! The store page for it is here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1735250/The_Little_Black_Bestiary_The_Salted_Cookies_of_Carthaginia_Soundtrack/


The planned price increase for the game is getting postponed for another week, so grab it while it's cheap! 



Also some typos have been fixed, a few expressions added/changed.
I'm sure we added more typos to make up for them though! Enjoy!

notes.title: Content Update Plan
notes.content:
There are two planned updates for this game.
The first one is coming next weekend (Ie: August 28th) which will continue the events of the afternoon, introduce Carthaginia's familiar Gerty as a character, have the protagonist play tech support for a bit, and add a new sex scene via an optional flashback. I don't really want to spoil the details, but I hope you will enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40745712/e468677ca2f9458b985733aa1c3f16e6e66e9f07.png[/img]

The second update will drop on October 1st and finish off the story into the night (adding another extensive sex scene.) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40745712/c4fecb4f3232df022f8d01a6168a7de780abf488.png[/img]

The VN's launch price was set at $3 due to being very short, but since these updates will more than double the amount of content available the price will increase to $4 after the first update. So this week is your chance to get it now at the lower price point. 

Also, when this weekend's update drops the 10-track OST will also become available for the same price. (The currently available release contains 6 tracks and each update will add two more tracks)
